intent: Keep operational credentials out of diagnostic rendering and internal network addresses out of route-canary relay projections without changing operational configuration or REST evidence.

criteria.requirement: Every config leaf is explicitly classified; new unclassified leaves fail closed and fail the schema guard; all protected subtrees redact JSON, YAML, fmt, Zap and slog.
Database parse errors and Gitea diagnostics share encoded-secret redaction without retaining unsafe error causes.
All three canary relay event kinds redact network endpoints while preserving diagnostic meaning and original REST/persistence payloads.
